name: agent-understudy
description: Swap secrets and PII for stand-ins in every conversation row before it is stored or sent; restore them where tools run; project credentials the model never sees

gateway.title: Engine URL (optional)
gateway.description: Leave empty: each session starts its own engine (no daemon). Set it to use a long-lived `understudy up` instead.

cli.title: agent-understudy command
cli.description: How to run the CLI that starts a session's engine

failClosed.title: Withhold content when no engine is reachable
failClosed.description: On: rows are replaced with a notice if they cannot be scanned. Off: they pass through unscanned.
